title: Laboratory for Laser Energetics — Student Education Programs (Rochester)
description:
The Laboratory for Laser Energetics, a national resource on Rochester's south campus, brings high school, undergraduate, and graduate students to work with mentors across inertial confinement fusion, high-energy-density physics, laser-plasma interaction, laser and optics sciences, and laser technology. LLE has run education programs since its founding in 1970 and employs undergraduates in real research roles on one of the world's most powerful laser facilities.
